dataset: ETOPO 2022 v1, 60 arc-second ice-surface global relief, served by NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
vertical_reference: EGM2008; z in meters, positive up
processing: Small spatial subset at stride four. Original z values retained; bilinear screen sampling for display. Bathymetric color classes use negative elevations. Few contours are generalized from a lightly smoothed display field; pale cartographic masks reduce detail behind text without changing source z values.
